title: MaxBLD lot report v2 — scenarios + offers
$comment: GENERATED by scripts/analysis/report-schema.mjs --write from scripts/surfaces/_schema/report-v2.decl.json. Do not edit. Every property carries x-source (its one source), x-status and, for lineage fields, x-trust-tier (the per-field trust map, O-17).

comp_fsi_p50_same_form.description: Typical FSI p50, this build type

nearby_coa_builds_gfa_sqm.description: Nearby CoA builds, same form (per card)

suite_openings_loss_sqm.description: Area lost if windows are added

lot_form_basis.description: How the lot form was detected

lot_form_effective.description: Lot form used for this report

lot_form_user_override.description: Correction: this isn't a semi — it's detached

addition_above_existing.template: On a lot of 12.2 m or less, an addition above the house keeps its setbacks (achieved if the house is lawfully existing).

ancillary_coverage_all_buildings.template: If all buildings on the lot together cover no more than 45 % of it, the limit on ancillary building coverage does not apply to a lot with a houseplex or a secondary suite.

attic_outside_gfa.template: The attic ({A} m²) is livable but not counted in the City's floor-area total (GFA): it does not meet the headroom and size test.

basement_becomes_storey.template: If the lowest level is raised so its midpoint is above the ground level the City measures from (established grade), it becomes a storey and counts in the floor-area total (GFA).

basement_excluded.template: The basement ({A} m²) is livable but not counted in the City's floor-area total (GFA).

basement_headroom_code.template: Basement headroom is set by the Building Code, not the zoning by-law.

basement_unit_grade.template: A basement unit may not be entirely below the ground level the City measures from (established grade).

bedroom_cap.template: Bedrooms are capped at {n} for {u} units.

blank_side_wall.template: Side walls are taken without windows or doors (0.45 m side yard); with them the side yard is {X} m.

buildings_on_same_lot.template: Rules for two or more residential buildings on one lot do not apply to the house and its suite.

coa_calibrated_not_law.template: The Committee of Adjustment (CoA) figure is estimated from past approved builds of this form; it is not a by-law limit. It covers the main building only; a rear suite has no CoA figure.

conversion_within_building.template: Added units must fit inside the building as it lawfully existed.

coxwell_area.template: This suite takes the Coxwell–Victoria Park reading of 150.7.60.30(1)(C): over 4.0 m tall at 5.0 m from the house. The City may read the 4.0 m height cap as applying below 7.5 m from the house; a written City interpretation is pending.

coxwell_may_qualify.template: This lot may be in the Coxwell–Victoria Park area, where a suite over 4.0 m may sit 5.0 m from the house.

decks_platforms_not_modelled.template: Decks, porches, balconies and platforms are not modelled; they have their own size and setback rules.

deep_side_setback.template: Any part of the house more than 17.0 m behind its front wall (or 19.0 m behind the required front setback) needs a 7.5 m side yard.

dormers_at_max.template: Dormers are taken at the 40 % maximum.

established_grade.template: Heights are measured from the ground level the City measures from (established grade), which is not known for this lot; on a sloped lot the usable height may differ.

exception_not_authored.template: A site-specific exception applies to this lot and is not yet evaluated; affected values are marked not evaluated.

existing_ancillary_setbacks.template: If the existing ancillary building is lawfully existing, a laneway suite in it may keep its setbacks.

existing_estimated.template: Existing-house dimensions are estimated from aerial massing; storeys are estimated.

existing_low_confidence.template: Low confidence in existing footprint — enter your dimensions.

existing_roof_alteration.template: Changing the existing roof line is limited (roof slope rules for altered roofs).

existing_storeys_needed.template: Enter the number of storeys of your house to see this result.

existing_walls_site_fact.template: If the existing walls are taller or closer to the lot lines than allowed, their lawful height and setbacks stand for them.

flat_roof_setback.template: The top storey is set back {s} m from the front and rear walls.

forms_deferred.template: Townhouse and apartment forms, and a secondary suite in a semi or townhouse, are not modelled in this release.

front_yard_averaging.template: The front setback ({X} m) averages the neighbouring houses' estimated setbacks; a survey may differ.

front_yard_needs_survey.template: The by-law sets this lot's front setback as the average of the neighbouring houses' setbacks (10.5.40.70(1)). We estimate those from building outlines, adjusted for porches, and show the larger of that and the zone's standard {X} m. A survey is needed.

front_yard_not_measured.template: The by-law sets this lot's front setback as the average of the neighbouring houses' setbacks (10.5.40.70(1)). We could not measure those reliably, so the zone's standard {X} m is shown; the actual setback may be larger or smaller. A survey is needed.

gfa_deductions_not_applied.template: The City's floor-area total (GFA) may also leave out garage, void and similar areas; these depend on the design and are not applied.

heritage_designated.template: The property is heritage-designated; changes need heritage approval beyond zoning.

holding_zone.template: The zoning has a holding symbol (H): new building must wait until the City lifts it.

irregular_lot_approximation.template: Lot frontage and depth are approximated from the lot shape; this lot is close to a threshold.

lane_centreline_original.template: The 2.5 m lane setback is measured from today's lane centreline; the by-law uses the original one.

laneway_upper_side_stepback.template: Above 4.0 m the laneway suite steps back 1.5 m from the side line that abuts another lot's rear line (applied).

lawfully_existing_relief.template: If the existing building or suite is lawfully existing, {clause} lets it keep its {height / setback / separation / size}.

main_entrance_height.template: The main front entrance may be no more than 1.2 m above the ground level the City measures from (established grade).

main_wall_pair.template: Maximum main-wall height {Hw} m applies to the {side / front and rear} walls for {p} % of their width.

major_street_forms_not_modelled.template: On a major street an apartment building (up to 60 units) or a townhouse may be permitted with larger limits; not modelled here.

mechanical_attic_excluded.template: {X} m² of the attic is taken as mechanical-equipment space, which the City leaves out of the floor-area total (GFA); achieved if that space holds the mechanical equipment.

one_storey_extension.template: The addition includes a one-storey rear extension of up to 2.0 m beyond the length limit.

other_ancillary_buildings.template: If the lot has other ancillary buildings, they count toward the {20 / 30} % ancillary coverage.

r_pre1953_fsi_relief.template: If the house was built before 15 October 1953, a rear addition may bring the total floor area to 0.69 times the lot area (FSI 0.69).

r_roof_slope.template: In the R zone a detached house's roof above the second storey may be no steeper than 5 vertical to 3 horizontal; the roof design is not checked.

ravine_protection.template: The property is in a ravine protection area; a separate ravine permit may limit the building area.

rear_addition_floor_levels.template: In the R zone a rear addition's floors may not rise above the existing top floor.

renovation_position_unknown.template: The addition is an area difference; the existing building's position on the lot is not known.

roof_form_alternate.template: A {flat roof with a set-back top storey / pitched roof with an attic} gives {X} m².
slots: flat roof with a set-back top storey / pitched roof with an attic

rooftop_elements_exempt.template: Rooftop equipment, skylights, antennae, solar devices and similar elements may exceed the building or suite height within limits.

secondary_suite_share_reading.template: If the City reads 45 % against the main unit only, the suite is limited to {X} m².

semi_detached_house_not_modelled.template: A new semi-detached house (with or without a secondary suite) may be built on this half-semi lot; not modelled here.

semi_house_two_lots.template: If the semi-detached house is divided onto two lots, each lot's minimums are 50 %.

semi_party_wall.template: This assumes the lot holds half of a semi-detached building; the party wall stays.

setback_encroachments.template: Bay windows, wall-mounted equipment and similar parts may project into a setback within set limits; they are design details and are not modelled.

shoreline_hazard.template: If a shoreline hazard limit or stable top-of-bank crosses or is near the lot, the land below it does not count toward the allowed floor area (FSI), and buildings must stay 10 m from it.

side_yard_shift.template: One side yard may be up to 0.3 m narrower if the other side yard is made wider by the same amount; the side yard shown is the standard one.

sixplex_height_conditions.template: 10.5 m is achieved if the lowest level is raised 1.0–1.5 m and holds a dwelling unit.

suite_counts_toward_u.template: If the 'u' label counts the suite, the lot's unit cap applies to both units.

suite_coverage_option.template: Coverage uses option {A/B}; the other gives {X} m².

suite_gfa_reductions.template: The suite's attic, mechanical, basement and void areas are not counted in its floor-area total (GFA).

suite_lot_fact_unknown.template: {Fact} is not known for this lot; the larger setback ({X} m) is used.

suite_openings_setback.template: If the suite has windows/doors in its {rear / side} wall: setback {X} m, suite reduced by {Y} m². This applies only if the {rear lot line abuts a residential lot / side lot line does not abut a street}.
slots: rear lot line abuts a residential lot / side lot line does not abut a street

suite_parking_bicycle.template: No parking is required with the suite; it must provide two bicycle parking spaces.

suite_parking_variants.template: A suite containing a parking space has larger rear / side setbacks.

suite_separation_arm.template: A 6.3 m suite needs 7.5 m from the house; at 4.0 m from the house the suite is limited to 4.0 m.

suite_soft_landscaping.template: Soft landscaping (grass or planting) of {X} m² is required {behind the house / between the house and the suite}; a suite of this size must still leave that area.
slots: behind the house / between the house and the suite

through_lot_front_line.template: This is a through lot; the front lot line is taken on {street}, the street the neighbouring lots face. If the City sets the other street line as the front, the front and rear setbacks swap.

townhouse_driveway_width.template: Townhouse unit width/frontage is 5.0 m per unit without a private driveway, 6.0 m with one.

triangular_lot.template: The lot has no rear lot line; the rear setback is measured as a radius from where the side lot lines meet.

unit_count_reduced.template: Units reduced to {n} so each has at least {m} m².

vacant_existing_lot.template: If this is a vacant lot that existed before the current rules, a house or detached houseplex may be built on it only if the lot frontage is at least 6.0 m and it meets the rest of the by-law.
